content_html:
DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 Vision (NVFP4)

DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 with sight. This development checkpoint connects DeepSeek's reasoning and agentic backbone to the MoonViT vision encoder from Kimi-K2.6 through WebBrain's trained, routing-aware PatchMerger projector.

This is a complete copy of MJPansa's source-preserving 0731 NVFP4 conversion with WebBrain's frozen MoonViT tower, trained PatchMerger projector, routing bridge, and custom SGLang integration added in the same repository.

The text checkpoint is mixed precision: routed expert weights are NVFP4 while attention, shared experts, head, MTP, and other ignored paths preserve the source 0731 formats described by config.json, hf_quant_config.json, and conversion-receipt.json. It is not an all-NVFP4 checkpoint.

Why vision at WebBrain

At WebBrain, we build browser agents that need to understand the visual state of the web—not just extracted text. Screenshots, charts, dashboards, rich editors, and the location and appearance of controls are part of real browser work, so vision is a practical product requirement.

In our American–Chinese open-model frontier benchmark, DeepSeek V4 Flash stood out as a strong and cost-efficient model, while the upstream checkpoint remains text-only. This project attaches a MoonViT vision bridge while keeping the language backbone and vision tower frozen.

Contents

Component Provenance Status
Text checkpoint MJPansa/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-NVFP4 at 64d64cd89bc63a66aa46506da89d7821f7491c62 48 shards; copied server-side without tensor changes
Conversion source deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 at 9e165c30e2704aec5d9d593cce3eebd58bbef1cb 0731 DSpark/MTP tensors preserved
Vision tower MoonViT-3d extracted from moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 at 7eb5002f6aadc958aed6a9177b7ed26bb94011bb 329 BF16 tensors; frozen
Projector WebBrain PatchMerger, trained with the text backbone and tower frozen 6 BF16 tensors; 40,119,040 parameters
Serving External DeepSeek/MoonViT SGLang model and processor Experimental; source patch required

The added components are byte-identical to the published WebBrain vision artifacts:

File Size SHA-256
vision_tower.safetensors 833,765,768 bytes 1382c41f1a4afc91791ade630e2b1e1cef68cc5a1e09668a45970a5d5e1b8f15
mm_projector.safetensors 80,238,568 bytes 7024d9d5c9714c7abbc09abda015f083b7d7b107745eb78879f019bf4721577a

The initial mirror commit, 3457594532d890f8a46c18dda72d6a85c94ab418, matched all 78 source paths, sizes, Git blobs, and LFS SHA-256 values (175,573,280,882 bytes). The final package intentionally replaces the model card and augments config.json and model.safetensors.index.json so the vision components can be discovered. The 48 text shards remain unchanged.

See VISION_ADAPTER_MANIFEST.json and the preserved conversion-receipt.json for machine-readable provenance.

Build status

  • Pin and exactly mirror the source-preserving 0731 NVFP4 conversion.
  • Preserve all 48 text shards, the conversion receipt, and 0731 DSpark/MTP tensors.
  • Preserve mixed-precision metadata: routed experts are NVFP4 while ignored attention, shared-expert, head, and MTP paths retain their source formats.
  • Add and fingerprint-verify the frozen BF16 MoonViT tower.
  • Add and fingerprint-verify the trained BF16 PatchMerger projector.
  • Add the routing palette, external processor/model package, source patch, launch wrapper, and regression tests.
  • Augment the source config and index without changing upstream text tensor mappings or quantization metadata.
  • Pass a full-model GPU loader/startup gate and live image-generation smoke test with the established deployment path.
  • Run fresh text-parity and live image-generation smoke tests on the target Blackwell hardware and SGLang image.

Integration details

The projector performs:

LayerNorm -> 2x2 patch merge -> Linear(4608, 4608) -> GELU -> Linear(4608, 4096)

Text token routing IDs are preserved. Image positions receive deterministic routing IDs from the checked-in 64-ID palette. The integration currently supports one literal <image> marker and targets at most 512 merged image tokens.

This is not a stock Transformers or stock SGLang multimodal architecture. Use the checked-in external model/processor package and the SGLang revision pinned in docs/SGLANG_DEPLOYMENT.md.

Validation status

  • Exact source mirror metadata was verified before the vision overlay.
  • Both added safetensors files were verified by LFS SHA-256 after publication.
  • The source config's architecture, 0731 DSpark fields, mixed FP8/NVFP4 quantization metadata, and per-layer routed-expert map are preserved; only vision metadata was added.
  • The index still references the same 48 text shards and additionally maps the 335 vision/projector tensor names.
  • A full GPU loader/startup and image-generation smoke test has not yet been rerun for this assembled 0731 checkpoint. Earlier validation of the same vision adapter and SGLang glue with another NVFP4 text package is not claimed as validation here.

Usage

Download the complete repository, then point the included wrapper at that local snapshot:

export DEEPSEEK_VISION_MODEL_PATH=/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-Vision-NVFP4
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_PYTHONPATH="$DEEPSEEK_VISION_MODEL_PATH/sglang_ext"
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_KERNEL_PROFILE=blackwell-native
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_TP=4
scripts/launch_sglang_moonvit.sh

Treat the Blackwell profile as a starting configuration, not a validation claim. Begin with SGLang's native /generate endpoint as documented in the deployment guide. OpenAI chat image parts, production concurrency, CUDA graphs, and broad quality behavior remain unvalidated.

Licenses

The converted text files retain the terms and notices from their source. The MoonViT-derived tower is covered by LICENSE_KIMI_K2.6. The WebBrain projector and integration source are provided under the terms included with this repository. Downstream users are responsible for satisfying all applicable licenses.

Method credit

The overall construction and model-card approach was inspired by Baseten's GLM-5.2-Vision-NVFP4: keep the text backbone and MoonViT tower frozen, train a compact PatchMerger projector between them, and publish provenance and hardware constraints explicitly. Credit to the Baseten team for demonstrating this practical recipe.

This project adds a DeepSeek-specific routing bridge so mixed text/image embeddings preserve hash-routed text behavior. It does not reuse Baseten model weights, benchmark results, or deployment artifacts.

Acknowledgements

Built on DeepSeek AI's DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, MJPansa's source-preserving 0731 NVFP4 conversion, and Moonshot AI's Kimi-K2.6, with the vision-attachment method inspired by Baseten's GLM-5.2-Vision-NVFP4. These teams were not involved in this experimental development checkpoint; please do not direct issues with this repository to them.

Want this model on your inference provider?

Ask your inference provider—such as OpenRouter or another managed inference service—to deploy this exact repository with its multimodal processor and serving plugin. Deploying only the upstream text model will not enable image input. Providers should complete the fresh 0731 GPU validation gates above before offering it as a production endpoint.

Experimental status, roadmap, and get involved

Experimental vision checkpoint. Repository assembly, provenance, hashes, and source preservation have been verified, but a fresh full GPU loader and image-generation smoke test has not been run for this 0731 package. This is not a production-readiness or quality claim. Fine-grained OCR, small-object and control identification, GUI grounding, hallucination calibration, concurrency, and broader hardware coverage still need evaluation. Do not use this model as the sole decision source for safety-critical automation. The roadmap includes larger and more diverse datasets, higher-resolution OCR/UI examples, and broader parameter-efficient tuning. Interested in contributing evaluation or training data, sponsoring compute, or working with us as a design partner? Tell us here.

content_html_zh:
DeepSeek V4 闪存 0731 视觉 (NVFP4)

带瞄准器的 DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731。 该开发检查点通过 WebBrain 训练有素的路由感知 PatchMerger 投影仪将 DeepSeek 的推理和代理骨干网连接到 Kimi-K2.6 的 MoonViT 视觉编码器。

这是 MJPansa 的源代码保留 0731 NVFP4 转换的完整副本，其中包含 WebBrain 的冻结 MoonViT 塔、训练有素的 PatchMerger 投影仪、路由桥以及在同一存储库中添加的自定义 SGLang 集成。

文本检查点是混合精度：路由专家权重是 NVFP4，而注意力、共享专家、head、MTP 和其他忽略路径保留 config.json、hf_quant_config.json 和 conversion-receipt.json 描述的源 0731 格式。 它不是全 NVFP4 检查点。

为什么选择 WebBrain 的愿景

在 WebBrain，我们构建的浏览器代理需要了解网络的视觉状态，而不仅仅是提取的文本。 屏幕截图、图表、仪表板、丰富的编辑器以及控件的位置和外观是真实浏览器工作的一部分，因此视觉是一项实际的产品要求。

在我们的中美开放模型前沿基准测试中，DeepSeek V4 Flash 作为一个强大且具有成本效益的模型脱颖而出，而上游检查点仍然是纯文本。 该项目附加了一个 MoonViT 视觉桥，同时保持语言主干和视觉塔冻结。

内容

成分 出处 地位
文本检查点 MJPansa/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-NVFP4 位于 64d64cd89bc63a66aa46506da89d7821f7491c62 48 个碎片；复制服务器端而不改变张量
转换来源 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 位于 9e165c30e2704aec5d9d593cce3eebd58bbef1cb 第0731章 保留的DSpark/MTP张量
远景塔 MoonViT-3d 从 Moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 中提取，位于 7eb5002f6aadc958aed6a9177b7ed26bb94011bb 329 BF16 张量；冷冻的
投影仪 WebBrain PatchMerger，使用文本主干和冻结塔进行训练 6 个 BF16 张量； 40,119,040 个参数
服务 外部 DeepSeek/MoonViT SGLang 模型和处理器 实验性；需要源码补丁

添加的组件与已发布的 WebBrain 视觉工件的字节相同：

File Size SHA-256
Vision_tower.safetensors 833,765,768 bytes 1382c41f1a4afc91791ade630e2b1e1cef68cc5a1e09668a45970a5d5e1b8f15
mm_projector.safetensors 80,238,568 bytes 7024d9d5c9714c7abbc09abda015f083b7d7b107745eb78879f019bf4721577a

初始镜像提交 3457594532d890f8a46c18dda72d6a85c94ab418 匹配所有 78 个源路径、大小、Git blob 和 LFS SHA-256 值（175,573,280,882 字节）。 最终的包有意替换了模型卡并增强了 config.json 和 model.safetensors.index.json，以便可以发现视觉组件。 48 个文本碎片保持不变。

请参阅 VISION_ADAPTER_MANIFEST.json 和保留的 conversion-receipt.json 以了解机器可读的出处。

构建状态

  • 引脚并精确镜像保留源的 0731 NVFP4 转换。
  • 保留所有 48 个文本分片、转换收据和 0731 DSpark/MTP 张量。
  • 保留混合精度元数据：路由专家是 NVFP4，而忽略注意力、共享专家、头和 MTP 路径保留其源格式。
  • 添加并指纹验证冻结的 BF16 MoonViT 塔。
  • 添加并验证经过训练的 BF16 PatchMerger 投影仪。
  • 添加路由选项板、外部处理器/模型包、源补丁、启动包装器和回归测试。
  • 增强源配置和索引，而不更改上游文本张量映射或量化元数据。
  • 使用已建立的部署路径通过全模型 GPU 加载程序/启动门和实时图像生成冒烟测试。
  • 在目标 Blackwell 硬件和 SGLang 图像上运行新的文本奇偶校验和实时图像生成烟雾测试。

整合细节

投影机执行：

LayerNorm -> 2x2 patch merge -> Linear(4608, 4608) -> GELU -> Linear(4608, 4096)

保留文本令牌路由 ID。 图像位置从签入的 64-ID 调色板接收确定性路由 ID。 该集成当前支持一个文字 <image> 标记，并且目标最多 512 个合并图像标记。

这不是普通的 Transformers 或普通的 SGLang 多模式架构。 使用签入的外部模型/处理器包和固定在 docs/SGLANG_DEPLOYMENT.md 中的 SGLang 修订版。

验证状态

  • 在视觉叠加之前验证了确切的源镜像元数据。
  • 两个添加的安全张量文件在发布后均经过 LFS SHA-256 验证。
  • 保留源配置的架构、0731 DSpark 字段、混合 FP8/NVFP4 量化元数据和每层路由专家图；仅添加了视觉元数据。
  • 该索引仍然引用相同的 48 个文本分片，并另外映射 335 个视觉/投影仪张量名称。
  • 尚未针对此组装的 0731 检查点重新运行完整的 GPU 加载程序/启动和图像生成烟雾测试。 此处未将同一视觉适配器和 SGLang 粘合与另一个 NVFP4 文本包的早期验证视为验证。

Usage

下载完整的存储库，然后将包含的包装器指向该本地快照：

export DEEPSEEK_VISION_MODEL_PATH=/models/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-Vision-NVFP4
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_PYTHONPATH="$DEEPSEEK_VISION_MODEL_PATH/sglang_ext"
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_KERNEL_PROFILE=blackwell-native
export DEEPSEEK_VISION_TP=4
scripts/launch_sglang_moonvit.sh

将 Blackwell 配置文件视为起始配置，而不是验证声明。 从 SGLang 的本机 /generate 端点开始，如部署指南中所述。 OpenAI 聊天图像部分、生产并发、CUDA 图表和广泛的质量行为仍未经过验证。

许可证

转换后的文本文件保留其来源的条款和声明。 MoonViT 衍生的塔由 LICENSE_KIMI_K2.6 覆盖。 WebBrain 投影仪和集成源是根据此存储库中包含的条款提供的。 下游用户有责任满足所有适用的许可证。

方法学分

整体构造和模型卡方法的灵感来自 Baseten 的 GLM-5.2-Vision-NVFP4：保持文本主干和 MoonViT 塔冻结，在它们之间训练紧凑的 PatchMerger 投影仪，并明确发布出处和硬件约束。 感谢 Baseten 团队展示了这个实用的配方。

该项目添加了一个 DeepSeek 特定的路由桥，因此混合文本/图像嵌入可以保留哈希路由的文本行为。 它不会重用 Baseten 模型权重、基准测试结果或部署工件。

致谢
